validity_notes: VN-1 GATE DISPOSITION IS PRE-REGISTERED, NOT A POST-HOC CALL: frozen V4 (n_admitted >= MIN_ADMITTED = 40) failed with n_admitted = 31, and frozen G3 maps that to status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID with decision=NO_DATA and zero revalidation GETs spent. The absence of a persistence-economics result is representation loss, not a scientific negative; decide() returned NO_DATA and is structurally incapable of returning FALSIFIES on an empty row set.

VN-2 OUTCOME MAPPING: the packet contract enum has no NO_DATA value, so outcome=NOT_APPLICABLE is used, following the identical precedent in this thread (research/experiments/EXP-FRONTIER-38188815194/result.json: status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome=NOT_APPLICABLE for its representation-loss gate failure). No treatment object was measured at any cost, hazard or verdict level, so INCONCLUSIVE (reserved by frozen G4 for the case where the treatment object exists but its cycle never completed) would overstate what happened.

VN-3 THE FAILING POPULATION IS SHAPED BY THE CRAWL POLICY, NOT MEASURED WEB LOSS: 363 of 402 discovered deep URLs were never fetched because FIFO traversal stops fetching at discovery-budget exhaustion while doc.rust-lang.org and pandas.pydata.org exhaust BUDGET=250 at hop<=2. 67.39% of all discovered URLs were never fetched. The census-gate failure is therefore a substrate/census-interaction defect, and this packet says nothing about how much of the deep stratum still exists on the live Web.

VN-4 DISCLOSED, NON-DECISIONAL COUNTERFACTUAL ARITHMETIC (must not be read as an outcome): had the gate-failed 31-item population been admitted, the frozen decide() inputs would have been cold=302, N=31, mean_path=4.0645, |union|=42, i.e. cold/N=9.742 and both margin tests would have passed (A: 9.742-4.065=5.677 >= 0.974; B: 302-42=260 >= 30.2). decide() was NOT applied to these rows, no cycle was run, the primary label is fixed by G3, and this arithmetic is recorded solely to show that MIN_ADMITTED=40 removed a store-favourable population. It must not be used as a substitute measurement, as a licence to lower MIN_ADMITTED, or as evidence that the persistence mechanism wins.

VN-5 DISCOVERY-vs-GET UNIT MISMATCH IN THE INHERITED CONSTANTS: the inherited 926 (and the mandate's 833.4 batch threshold and 4.006731 per-item threshold) is the frozen frame's per-host DISCOVERED-URL count, not a GET count - the same 926 was rediscovered here while only 302 GETs were spent, and the parent's own cited per-GET artifact (run/raw/economics.jsonl) does not exist in the repository. The live ledger-measured M-COLD-BATCH-GETS=302 is reported separately from M-COLD-BATCH-DISCOVERED=926 so the two units cannot be conflated again. This is a statement about inherited constants, not about the current experiment, whose cost unit is internally consistent.

VN-6 V12 COULD NOT BE EXERCISED ON THE TREATMENT: with zero cycles there is no store cost to reconcile against a physical spend. The census side does reconcile exactly (28 + 5 + 302 = 335 GETs), so C-ACCOUNTING-RECONCILIATION is recorded as UNKNOWN rather than PASS or FAIL.

VN-7 LIVE CONTROL SENSITIVITY WAS NOT EXERCISED: the five control URLs were fetched once (all HTTP 200) and the run aborted before a second observation, so M-LIVE-POS-CHANGE and M-LIVE-NULL-CHANGED are null, not false. No invalidation observation of any kind exists in this packet, so the hazard axis (M-CHANGE-RATE, M-DEAD-RATE, M-FALSE-ACCEPT-NAIVE, M-HAZARD-RATE-UB95, M-FALSE-ACCEPT-UB95, M-TAU-LADDER) is entirely unmeasured and nothing here may be read as 'nothing changes'.

VN-8 SURVIVOR CONDITIONING (V11) IS UNCHANGED AND REINFORCED: every admitted item is conditional on having survived the census, and this run shows the conditioning is severe in the opposite direction too - 8 of 39 fetched deep URLs (20.5%) failed at census time, and the 363 unfetched deep URLs have unknown status. No pre-census or lifetime hazard statement may be derived from this packet.

VN-9 SINGLE VANTAGE, SESSION REGIME, WEB-WORK COST MODEL: one runner egress IP, credential-free GET-only stdlib urllib, no cookies, no browser/Docker/model calls, and a cost model that counts GETs and bytes only (excludes model calls/tokens/latency), inherited unchanged from prereg section 1. No statement here externalises across ASN, geography or egress IP.

VN-10 UNCONDITIONAL GETS AND BYTE-LEVEL PROXY: no If-None-Match is sent (conservative for the treatment, more bytes fetched), and a sha256 difference would over-count semantic invalidation. Neither could be exercised here because no cycle ran, but both remain frozen properties of the unexecuted treatment.

VN-11 ENVELOPE AND BUDGET HAD AMPLE HEADROOM: 32.0 s of a 620 s module budget and 335 of 3200 GETs, with no per-host time truncation. The designed V8 risk (an over-running measurement destroyed by the harness) did not materialise; the blocking defect was population registration, not runtime.

unresolved: U-1 Whether the persistence-maintenance/invalidation economics question is answerable at all on the live documentation substrate with a census policy that actually fetches its deep stratum: the deep stratum was discovered (402 hop>=3 URLs) but 90.3% of it was never fetched, so the population's size and the store's geometry remain unmeasured.

U-2 How much of the deep stratum still exists on the live Web: 363 discovered deep URLs have unknown status and 8 of 39 fetched deep URLs were dead/errored at census time. The frozen design contains no arm distinguishing page-gone (HTTP 404) from page-delinked or unreachable-under-policy, so the cause of the deep-stratum shortfall cannot be separated from this packet.

U-3 All outcome-bearing quantities remain unmeasured: revalidation GETs/bytes/elapsed, change/dead/moved counts and rates, naive-replay false-accept rate, hazard and false-accept 95% upper bounds, the tau tolerance ladder, endpoint-only fallback residuals (M-INTERIOR-ONLY-FAILS) and break-even cycles/density. Only M-WINDOWS-COMPLETED=0 and M-REVALIDATION-GETS-SPENT=0 are established.

U-4 Whether a store built on a properly fetched deep population would clear the frozen margin rule: the disclosed VN-4 arithmetic is not a measurement, and the population it describes is unrepresentative (2 of 4 hosts contributed nothing, cold/N is inflated by the same starvation that produced the gate failure).

U-5 Whether the discovery-budget policy (BUDGET=250 with discovery-time truncation of the fetch queue) is the correct census policy for a deep-stratum population at all: this is a substrate-design question owned by runtime/C-MEAS-VALID, not answerable inside this frozen packet, and it is the smallest identified unblocking action.

U-7 Whether the harness envelope now accommodates the designed ladder: V8 passed with 32 s of 620 s used and no truncation, so the envelope repair appears successful, but the treatment's full 3-cycle cost (~42 GETs/cycle here, ~200+ on the frozen-frame expectation) was never exercised.
